summary.zh: 安装前需在手机端开启经典 TCP ADB（Stellar/Shizuku TCP 或 adb tcpip）；插件自动查找端口并保持连接，并让 AI 主动执行系统级 adb 命令（开启自动批准时可能不经再次确认）。
summary.en: Requires classic TCP ADB enabled on the phone (Stellar/Shizuku TCP or adb tcpip) before installing. Finds the ADB port and keeps it connected, and lets the AI run system-level adb commands proactively, which may run without another prompt when auto-approval is on.
